title: Gentle Back Vibration
summary: The palms create light rhythmic oscillations over soft tissue without striking or abrupt movement.
goal: Add a brief, rhythmic relaxation technique near the end of the massage.
imageAlt: Educational diagram of gentle back vibration without text labels.
startingPosition: The person lies face down. Keep the palm fully in contact with a soft muscular area.
instructions: Place the palm on a soft area of the back.
Create small, quick oscillations without striking.
Continue for a few seconds, then move gently to the next area.
direction: Small oscillations in place, gradually moving across soft tissue.
tips: Avoid tensing the practitioner's wrist and shoulder.
mistakes: Prolonged vibration over one sensitive spot.
warning: Do not perform this technique over acute pain, recent injury, significant inflammation, damaged skin, or when touch increases symptoms. Seek qualified professional advice when uncertain.
